answer: Enrollment runs as one serialized chain. Each new agent publishes a sequential-delay proof extending its predecessor's proof, and the registry admits one link per interval, so no amount of rented hardware compresses the wait. A farm wanting ten thousand identities queues behind every honest applicant, or pays a non-refundable fee for the next slot out of its clone budget. Fake population grows only as fast as money is spent. Anyone staking an ember to fake a crowd waits a canyon of weeks for the thousandth clone, while the velvet story of independent users thins.
